Description: Self-contained Configure Persistent Data regression. Allocates a new UUID instance in the fixed fmIDE store, checks for a collision before writing, captures the action outcome, and deletes only its own instance after the assertion. No dependency on another test or the HelloWorld example. Added 2026-10-14.
Title: fmIDE Persistent regression 01 - All parameters evaluate once at runtime
fmIDE_Parameter: [+].Set Error Capture = 1[+].Set[:]..target = "$pd_id"[:]..calculation = == "fmIDE_Test.PersistentRegression." & Get ( UUID )[+].If = == not IsEmpty ( FilterValues ( ListPersistentDataIDs ( "fmIDE" ) ; $pd_id ) )[+].Exit Script = == "Fixture collision: no existing resource will be modified"[+].End If[+].Set[:]..target = "$pd_calls"[:]..calculation = == 0[+].Set[:]..target = "$pd_value"[:]..calculation = == "defined by a previous action"#@test[+].Configure Persistent Data[:]..instance_id = == Let ( $pd_calls = $pd_calls + 1 ; $pd_id )[:]..calculation = == Let ( $pd_calls = $pd_calls + 1 ; $pd_value )[:]..delete = == Let ( $pd_calls = $pd_calls + 1 ; 0 )#@endtest[+].Set[:]..target = "$pd_result"[:]..calculation = == JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; ["error" ; $$fmide_get_last_error ; JSONNumber] ; ["present" ; not IsEmpty ( FilterValues ( ListPersistentDataIDs ( "fmIDE" ) ; $pd_id ) ) ; JSONBoolean] ; ["value" ; GetPersistentData ( "fmIDE" ; $pd_id ) ; JSONString] ; ["calls" ; $pd_calls ; JSONNumber] )[+].Set[:]..target = "$pd_cleanup_error"[:]..calculation = == 0[+].If = == not IsEmpty ( FilterValues ( ListPersistentDataIDs ( "fmIDE" ) ; $pd_id ) )[+].Configure Persistent Data[:]..instance_id = == $pd_id[:]..delete = == 1[+].Set[:]..target = "$pd_cleanup_error"[:]..calculation = == $$fmide_get_last_error[+].End If[+].Exit Script = == JSONSetElement ( $pd_result ; ["cleanupError" ; $pd_cleanup_error ; JSONNumber] ; ["cleaned" ; not ( not IsEmpty ( FilterValues ( ListPersistentDataIDs ( "fmIDE" ) ; $pd_id ) ) ) ; JSONBoolean] )
